items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Duke would mention his name now and then -- but you never heard too much about him

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, because they was there together and Freddie Guy, you know. They would talk about him but you never heard too much -- Duke would mention his name now and then -- but you never heard too much about him, because after Billy Taylor came in his place they forgot about him.
